assistant_visual_precheck.observation: Both endpoints contain large dark green/gray smeared fills at the outer disoccluded regions. The adapter does not visibly improve over Big-LaMa enough to justify geometry generation, although it avoids MAT's specific false building/windows pattern.
assistant_visual_precheck.interpretation: The official networks execute correctly, but their local LDI-derived training protocol does not transfer to the large alpha-derived full-frame holes through this v1 adapter.

manual_review.notes: 主要问题仍是生成了虚假建筑。

decision: User confirmed static-gate failure. Stop this adapter at v1; do not build supplement Gaussians, rerun videos, expand to P02/P05, or tune parameters to hide the protocol mismatch.
